messages:
leo_sales: Quick heads-up: BeaconTech returned our MSA/DPA with redlines and says theyll only issue a PO before the Order Form is fully countersigned. Their asks: Net45, PO explicitly referencing the Order Form number, auditor access language, and an HSM clause. POC onboarding paused until PO is in.

tara_ops: Can we run a POC on PO-only? Ops needs to know what guardrails to apply if MSA is outstanding.

omar_billing: Finance can accept a PO as trigger but we need either: (a) PO that references the Order Form and includes billing entity + tax id; or (b) prepayment or capped trial credit while MSA unsigned. Net45 only after verification.

nicole_legal: I reviewed the redlines. They expand auditor access and add indemnity language tied to HSM. I dont want to accept unfettered audit rights. Proposal: "Provisional Access Addendum" limited to 30 days, scoped audit extracts (read-only via portal), and clear expiration if MSA unsigned. I can draft a tight addendum today.

anya_sec: Security: we have SOC2 Type II summary ready. We dont publish an HSM attestation. For POC we can offer a KMS placeholder and enforce short retention + no export. For regulated customers, HSM available on Private deployment but thats 2-3 weeks.

leo_sales: Customer says PO will be sent today and will include OF ref. Would provisional addendum + PO be acceptable to start provisioning?

tara_ops: If we accept provisional terms, ops will: enforce 14-day retention, disable data exports, restrict access to named ACCT contacts, and spin up a dedicated sandbox. ETA 4 business days after PO + billing info + signed ack of addendum.

omar_billing: Ask customer to attach PO PDF to billing@redwood.com and include billing contact and tax/VAT info. We'll map PO to invoice flow once validated.

nicole_legal: Action plan: Ill draft Provisional Access Addendum with short Exhibit A (ops checklist) and limited audit scope. If they push broader rights we escalate.

leo_sales: I'll request PO PDF and get the billing contact. Also pushing them to accept the addendum language.

anya_sec: Ill attach SOC2 summary and a short note on HSM roadmap for the thread.

tara_ops: Infra slot tentatively next Wednesday. Need PO + billing + addendum ack to lock it.

leo_sales: Customer just confirmed: "PO will reference OF-2026-540 and will be sent today. We can sign the Provisional Addendum." Uploading PO when it lands.

omar_billing: Once PO arrives, please cc billing. We'll confirm entity and tax info and advise on invoicing flow.

nicole_legal: Draft addendum uploaded to thread. If accepted, ops can proceed.

leo_sales: Thanks all. Will post PO PDF and any customer counters here. :thumbsup:
